acceptanceCriteria: A reproduction pins why the OCM linked none; the fix links added requirement IDs from the intent spec, with a test.
body: Residual from V1-2039/V1-2040 (PR #1317, TSA-V0-410..419). The PR #1317 dogfood-check SUMMARY reported `requirements=0 linked=0` though the INTENTS file named docs/specs/test-source-analysis-v0.md and the diff added TSA-V0-410..419. Other lanes (e.g. #1316) report requirements=3 linked=3. Expected: requirements added by the diff in the named spec are linked. Inputs: /private/tmp/cem10-build/erj2039/.
title: dogfood-check OCM links no requirements (requirements=0 linked=0) although the intents file names the governing spec with new TSA-V0 IDs
